description: Detects hardware back button presses on Android, lets you register event listeners, and control app behavior on back press. Android-only.

addEventListener.description: Registers a handler function for the hardware back button press event. Returns a subscription object that can be removed.
addEventListener.signature: addEventListener(eventName: BackPressEventName, handler: () => boolean | null | undefined) => NativeEventSubscription

eventName.description: Name of the back press event to listen for.

handler.description: Function called when the back button is pressed. Return true to prevent default behavior, false to allow default behavior or let other listeners handle it.

addEventListener.returns: NativeEventSubscription object. Use subscription.remove() to unsubscribe.

notes: Event subscriptions are called in reverse order (last registered first).
Returning true in a handler prevents earlier subscriptions and system default behavior.
Returning false allows the event to bubble and invokes default behavior if no other listener handles it.
Does not work if a Modal is open (see React Native Modal docs).
For React Navigation, refer to Custom Android Back Button Behavior for integrating navigation actions.
